packet.verification: every clip copied with a matching SHA-256 (same excerpts as round 4); each decodes as 16-bit PCM WAV (Python wave) and loads in the Windows WAV decoder (System.Media.SoundPlayer.Load, no playback); every relative index and playlist link resolves inside the packet folder; the zip passes testzip and holds every clip. recording.format: 48 kHz stereo 32-bit float, WASAPI loopback of the default output device (whole device mix)

statements: Technical playback, timing and ownership: verified natively (one cue per resolved tail hit in its own frame, natural end; one cue per Trumpet Blast, natural end; retirement stops only its own playing ID).

Clip integrity and playback accessibility: every clip below was copied from the lab excerpt with a matching SHA-256, decodes as 16-bit PCM WAV (48 kHz stereo), and every link in this page and the playlist resolves to a file in this folder.
Actual listening: none. No agent in this workflow has supported audio perception, and no named reviewer has listened. Levels and event IDs do not show that anyone listened.
Subjective suitability and the final choice are yours. Sweetener_Low_06_Quake (impact) and InspireCourage (Trumpet) are kept provisionally; neither is acoustically accepted.
comparisons: Impact: play the two in-play tail hits (actual), then the isolated current sample, then each isolated alternative; choose whether to keep Sweetener_Low_06_Quake or name another.
Impact: compare the in-play hits with the quiet baseline to judge whether the cue is audible over the scene at gameplay distance (about 37 m camera to emitter).
Trumpet: play the in-play Trumpet Blast (actual), then the isolated current sample and the six alternatives; choose whether to keep InspireCourage.
Trumpet: compare with the Vrock Screech neighbour (same shared cue helper) for distinctness.
notes: Recording: WASAPI loopback of the default output device (whole device mix, not an isolated process), 48 kHz stereo 32-bit float, lab file runtime-evidence/s7/audio-r4/r4e-fx-device-audio.wav (SHA-256 f67b1d4f9294461f46f721cbc89b37c975ed94be650b312845fc25ae4b6ae37f), started 2026-11-24T17:07:17.5817796Z; excerpts are 16-bit PCM copies cut by UTC.

Listener: the Wwise listener follows the game camera; distances are camera to emitter. The two tail hits were measured in the resolving frame, the frame their cues posted. The Trumpet and Vrock in-play distances were observed one frame after posting (exact posting distance not available). Isolated sample distances were taken at the observer post.

Earlier excerpts (round 3, session 20261124T061437Z) remain in the lab at runtime-evidence/s7/review-r3/. Their tail-hit distance (37.45 m) was sampled after both strikes and a further 4 s wait, not at posting; the R6 Trumpet distance was not measured. They are not part of this packet.
Private: game audio from the owner installation. Do not commit, publish or attach it anywhere public.
